dict.string: LLM Hub needs permission to access your contacts to send SMS messages to contacts you specify.
LLM Hub needs permission to access your location to display nearby places and maps.
LLM Hub needs permission to access your calendar to create and view calendar events.
LLM Hub needs permission to add events to your calendar.
LLM Hub needs permission to access your reminders to set alarms and reminders.
LLM Hub needs permission to schedule alarms with the AI Agent.
